The ground floor features a large open-plan living and dining area measuring approximately 22"10" x 16"5", creating an ideal space for relaxing or entertaining. Double doors open onto a private decked area leading to the garden, perfect for outdoor dining and summer gatherings. Ground Floor: Open Plan Living & Garden Access A separate modern kitchen sits to the front of the property and includes ample worktop space and storage. This floor also benefits from a cloakroom/WC, additional storage and a dedicated cycle storage area. First Floor : Three Bedrooms & Family Bathroom The first floor offers three well-proportioned bedrooms, ideal for children, guests or home office use. A contemporary family bathroom serves this level, and built-in storage provides practical everyday convenience. Second Floor: Private Principal Suite Occupying the top floor is the spacious principal bedroom, offering privacy and comfort along with a modern en-suite shower room. This floor also provides access to a large private terrace, creating a peaceful outdoor retreat. Chobham Manor, located in the heart of Olympic Park in Stratford, East London, is the first of five new neighbourhoods, offering 850 stylish, high-quality homes. Residents enjoy proximity to world-class sports and entertainment venues, picturesque parks, and Westfield Stratford City a lifestyle destination featuring 250 shops, 70 dining options, a 17-screen all-digital Vue Cinema, luxury bowling centre, and casino. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity. Book a viewing today and discover all that this exceptional property has to offer!
